scope: People register only; CS-02, NFR-01, NFR-04. Synthetic proof, not production-load acceptance.

environment.analysis: No ANALYZE or planner setting changes; compatible locks prevent concurrent auto-analysis of the ten observed tables during native fixture construction and measurement.

oracle.isolation: Complete reader frozen before editing, only imports relocated. Imported builders unchanged. Plan test reverses relocation and asserts original SHA-256.

comparison: Exact binds, all raw fields and public fields including signed cursors, except observed_at. Each real SQL observation timestamp is checked against before/after database clock samples and must project unchanged to the public output. No SQL, result, clock or bind rewriting.
denominator: Reported visible total (31/46), not fixture size (30/45), default page (25), look-ahead (26) or SQL rows (1). Bound is 10 times visible total.
timing_policy: One warm EXPLAIN ANALYZE per reader/volume after the real query, frozen then fixed. Timing/buffers separate from loops; no latency distribution or asymptotic proof.

raw_artifact.retention: Reproducible ignored local capture: complete SQL/binds, plans and raw/public outputs.
